abstract: I remember seeing the first 8K images at IBC, and I was struck with feelings of awe, wonder, and incredulity in equal measure. The engineering marvel that I was witnessing—not just the display, but the entire ecosystem from glass to glass—was a wonder to behold. The sheer audacity of putting the system together made me proud to be in the industry. I was left with the question “Who wants this?”
